special_days.title: Special days
special_days.lede: A special day is a day of rest. Which dates those are in Slovakia comes from the public-holiday library — including the moving feasts (Good Friday, Easter Monday) and including the fact that since 2024 8 May, 1 and 15 September, 28 October and 17 November are state holidays but working days. That list is not editable. Click a day to add or remove this workplace's own exception.
